formattedAddress: No. 15, Lane 71, Section 2, Anhe Rd, Tong'an Village, Da’an District, Taipei City, Taiwan 106

text.text:
We had such a wonderful experience at Divino! From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly warm and welcoming. A special mention to Velma, who has always been the nicest friend and an absolutely amazing server. She took great care of us and gave us excellent suggestions throughout the meal.

The food was outstanding, we enjoyed perfectly cooked gnocchi, a delicious carbonara, and an amazing steak done just right. We finished with a beautiful panna cotta topped with a lovely red-fruit coulis. Everything was full of flavor and beautifully presented.

Overall, a very memorable experience. Highly recommended! 🙌🍽️

Absolutely fantastic experience! The food was outstanding—my favorite was the grilled octopus. It was perfectly tender, paired with a delicious sauce and creamy smashed potatoes.

The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, and the chefs were incredibly friendly. Sitting at the chef’s table made the evening even more special, as we got to interact with the chefs and watch the cooking process, which added a fun and unique touch.

A big thank-you to our friend Velma for introducing us to this place and making it such a memorable night!💕

The food was visually impressive, but the taste was rather standard.. Unfortunately, the herbs cooled down very quickly, possibly due to the strong air conditioning.  On the positive side, the staff were incredibly friendly and provided excellent service.

However, I don’t quite understand the hype around this place.  Maybe it's more about Instagram worthy photos than actual culinary quality?  Also, the place is small and narrow, and the toilet is surprisingly dark and cramped, which made me wonder if they’re trying to hide the dirt.  Either way, at least I can say I’ve tried it this type of modern presentation.  I’ll stick to my mama's La Cucina for an authentic Italian cuisine ."

text.text: Incredible experience at Divino Taipei, the food and the wine were fantastic. Everything was very tasty and authentic Italian food which is not always the case in Taipei. Special thanks to our waitress Velma for taking such good care of us, we will definitely come back!

text.text: Love the fact that it’s got attention to the details as well as the chilled vibe at the same time! The staffs are really friendly and mindful, the food itself is as authentic as I could imagine - highly recommended!
